#There are three file that make up this tool.# 1. chaturbate - main script. Watches to see when cams come online and starts recording. This should be run in a screen session named *chaturbate*. 2. recordCam - Does the actually rip. Can be run as a standalone. Standalone recordings should be run in a screen named cb_*modelname* 3. watchlist - Text file containing the names of the models you want to record. The main script reads this to find what to record.

All three files should go, together, into your executable path. (ie: ~/.bin, ~/local/.bin) Just >echo $PATH

to find a directory.

You may also want to add this to your .bashrc file to see what's being recorded in the background. ~~~ alias sls=$(screen -ls | awk '{ print $1 }' | awk -F '.' '{ print $2 }' | sort | sed -e '/^\s*$/d' | egrep "^cb_") ~~~

# watchlist - for recording multiple cams# Simply add the cam model names to a file named *watchlist*. Commented names will be skipped.

Example: ~~~ angelnovaaa #angelsdaniel #angrybirds_girl animergamergirl #anitablonds annabellpeaksxx ~~~

#Now the main script - chaturbate# It isn't necessary to run this unless you want to record/manage multiple cams. It will read the file *watchlist* and check for changes, so there is no need to restart the script if a change is made to the watchlist. Everything is designed to run invisible in the background so run this in a screen name *chaturbate*

~~~ #!/usr/bin/env bash clear

# cloudflare cookie - script will not work without this! cookie=

# check for needed progs if [[ ! $(which screen) ]] then echo "GNU Screen not found!" exit 1 # needed to run livestreamer in background fi

if [[ ! $(which curl) ]] then echo "GNU Curl not found!" # needed to check is cam is online exit 1 fi

if [[ ! $(which livestreamer) ]] then echo "Livestreamer not found!" # needed to rip stream exit 1 fi

scriptDIR=$(dirname $(readlink -f $0))

if [[ ! -f "${scriptDIR}/watchlist" ]] then echo "Cam watchlist not found. Location: ${scriptDIR}/watchlist" exit 1 fi

while true do cams=( )

for camModel in $(cat ${scriptDIR}/watchlist | egrep -v "^#") do cams+=( $camModel ) done

echo "Cams currently active:" for online in $(screen -ls | awk '{ print $1 }' | awk -F '.' '{ print $2 }' | sort | sed -e '/^\s*$/d' | egrep "^cb_") do echo -e "\e[0;32mOnline\e[0m -> $online" done

echo -e "Cams Online: \e[0;32m$(screen -ls | awk '{ print $1 }' | awk -F '.' '{ print $2 }' | sort | sed -e '/^\s*$/d' | egrep '^cb_' | wc -l)\e[0m" echo echo "Checking for active cams..."

for cam in ${cams[@]} do if [[ ! $(screen -ls | grep "$cam") ]] then if [[ $(curl -s "https://chaturbate.com/${cam}/" | grep ".m3u8") ]] then echo -e "\e[0;32mOnline\e[0m -> $cam [@$(date +'%H:%M')]" screen -d -m -S cb_${cam} ${scriptDIR}/recordCam $cam $cookie else echo -e "\e[0;31mOffline\e[0m <- $cam" fi else echo -e "\e[0;32mOnline\e[0m -> $cam" fi done echo echo "Waiting 1 minute for next round..." sleep 60 unset cams clear done

unset cookie unset scriptDIR ~~~

#The part that actually does the work - recordCam# This can be run as a standalone by invoking: ~~~ recordCam camModel token ~~~

~~~ #!/usr/bin/env bash

[[ ! $(which livestreamer) ]] && exit 1

screenName=$1

if [[ $2 ]] then cookie=$2 else clear echo -n "Enter valid cookie: " read cookie echo # token can be place here to skip the check. just comment out the rest of this check and set the cookie variable #cookie= fi

outdir="${HOME}/Videos/chaturbate" tmpdir="${HOME}/Videos/chaturbate/tmp"

mkdir -p $tmpdir mkdir -p $outdir

count=0 limit=10 # retry limit after connection is lost.

while [[ $count -lt $limit ]] do datetime=$(date +"%Y%m%d-%H%M%S") filename="${screenName}_${datetime}.m4v" clear livestreamer --rtmp-timeout 10 --http-cookie "csrftoken=$cookie" \ -o "${tmpdir}/${filename}" https://chaturbate.com/$(printf "%s" $1 | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')/ best [[ -f "${tmpdir}/${filename}" ]] && mv "${tmpdir}/${filename}" "${outdir}/${filename}" let count=$count+1 sleep 10 unset datetime unset filename done

unset cookie unset outdir unset tmpdir unset count unset filename

# closes screen session when cam goes offline screen -X -S cb_${screenName} quit ~~~
